newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS END FENERBAHCE'S EUROPEAN HOPES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS END FENERBAHCE'S EUROPEAN HOPES.

text.p: Holders Juventus, already through to the European Cup quarter-finals, dashed Fenerbahce's hopes of accompanying them by beating the Turks 2-0 in their final Champions' League group C match on Wednesday.

The Italians, whose place as group leaders was also untouchable, took the lead just before half time when striker Michele Padovano crashed in a header in the 41st minute off a well-placed cross from Mark Iuliano on the left wing.

Fenerbahce, who needed an unlikely win in the Delle Alpi stadium to be sure of going through, took the match to the home team in the early minutes and were unlucky not to score with Nigerians Uche Okechekwu and Augustine Okocha.
Okechekwu hit the crossbar with a bouncing header in the 17th minute while Okocha had a second half shot deflected around the upright.
Nicola Amoruso, who replaced Alessandro del Piero at half time, made it 2-0 six minutes from time.
The result left Juventus on 16 points, ahead of Manchester United on nine and Fenerbahce on seven.
